parameters.fetchXml:
<fetch version="1.0" output-format="xml-platform" mapping="logical" distinct="false">
  <entity name="new_assignmentrate">
    <attribute name="new_assignmentrateid" />
    <attribute name="new_name" />
    <attribute name="createdon" />
    <attribute name="new_ratetypeid" />
    <attribute name="new_payrate" />
    <attribute name="transactioncurrencyid" />
    <attribute name="new_billrate" />
    <order attribute="new_name" descending="false" />
    <filter type="and">
      <condition attribute="new_assignmentid" operator="eq"  uitype="new_assignment" value="@{triggerOutputs()?['body/new_assignmentid']}" />
       <condition attribute="new_ratetypeid" operator="eq" uiname="Standard Day" uitype="new_ratetype" value="{F95CF094-100C-EE11-8F6E-6045BD0CFCA3}" />

    </filter>
  </entity>
</fetch>
